sentences.en: What's the most addictive game you've ever played?
sentences.zh: 你玩过的最上瘾的游戏是什么？

sentences.en: I must warn you, this toy is addictive.
sentences.zh: 我必须警告你，这个玩具非常让人上瘾。

sentences.en: Sami said that weed was not very addictive.
sentences.zh: 萨米说大麻并不会使人特别容易上瘾。

senses.zh: 使成瘾的, 上瘾的 - (使人)入迷的，醉心的
